description: Create a spreadsheet to track high school reunion RSVPs. Set up a table with columns: Last Name, First Name, Email, Phone, RSVP Status, Bringing Guest?, Meal Choice, Notes. Enter data for 8 classmates (provided in instructions). Below the data, create a summary section with formulas to calculate: Total Confirmed (count 'Yes' responses), Total Headcount (confirmed + guests), meal counts by type (Vegetarian, Chicken, Beef), cost per person ($45), and expected revenue (headcount × cost). Apply bold formatting to column headers and currency formatting to monetary values. Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/reunion_tracker.xlsx.
